newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open slightly lower Monday in line with LME copper after a further rise in LME warehouse copper stocks Monday.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to down 0.50 cent from Friday's close of 111.45 cents a lb after trading from 111.00 to 110.70 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose 3,900 tonnes Monday to 214,125 tonnes, the highest level since early March, as the seasonally slow summer period continues to see demand ease.
COMEX copper stocks rose 151 short tons Friday to 25,189 short tons.
But a day of consolidation is seen likely after Friday's sharp gains on LME and COMEX which were prompted by shortcovering by funds as they took profits from the sell side for the previous month.
